rebuild_reason: boundary_method is now carried per row and is in the content-hash tuple. The census fold path would have folded 3,468 full-length sequences: core/enqueue.py branched on boundary_method, not on coordinates, and any unrecognised or absent value fell through to whole. The manifest carried no such column, so ingest would have had to invent one. It is now pre-registered in the manifest and ingest copies it. identity_fn_version 3.
span_definition_note: D-081: the 82-target cohort is frozen under v1-extracellular-substring-2026-07-21. Counts under the two definitions are not comparable unless both are named.
attention_tilt_limitation: The no_extracellular_span band correlates weakly with UniProt entry recency: Spearman rho = -0.142 against entryVersion and +0.120 against firstPublicDate, real at n≈2,800 but about 2% of variance, and the two proxies are mechanically confounded. Nothing is adjusted for it.

ceiling_recipe.provenance: S-004/S-005 bisection; band (440, 630) unmeasured pending D-077

identity_fn_version_note: 1 = revisions 1-3, no coordinates and no boundary_method (the tuple degenerates to accession/band/tier/rule/definition and a span change that moved neither band nor tier would still collide); 2 = revision 4, coordinates present; 3 = revision 5 onward, boundary_method present
